title.original: DeepCEE: Efficient Cross-Region Model Distributed Training System under Heterogeneous GPUs and Networks
title.zh: DeepCEE：异构GPU和网络下的高效跨区域模型分布式训练系统
title.en: DeepCEE: Efficient Cross-Region Model Distributed Training System under Heterogeneous GPUs and Networks

inclusion_reason.zh: DeepCEE 将异构设备分组、自动流水线并行和动态网络适配集成为跨区域训练运行时，明显越过单一算法边界。
inclusion_reason.en: DeepCEE integrates heterogeneous device grouping, automatic pipeline parallelism, and dynamic network adaptation into a cross-region training runtime, clearly exceeding an algorithm-only contribution.

abstract.zh: DeepCEE 是面向云—边—端异构 GPU 与不稳定跨区域网络的训练系统，以通信为中心完成设备分组、紧凑流水线并行和运行时自适应。
abstract.en: DeepCEE is a communication-centric training system for cloud-edge-end deployments with heterogeneous GPUs and unstable cross-region links, combining device grouping, compact pipeline parallelism, and runtime adaptation.

problem.zh: 分层跨区域拓扑同时存在算力差异、慢链路和网络波动，单区域训练系统的并行策略会产生长气泡或频繁失衡。
problem.en: Hierarchical cross-region topologies combine compute disparity, slow links, and network variation, causing strategies designed for one region to develop long bubbles and recurring imbalance.

approach.zh: 系统按计算与网络特征联合画像和分组设备，为设备组自动推导紧凑的零气泡流水线策略，并通过环境适配器响应链路变化。
approach.en: The system profiles and groups devices jointly by compute and network characteristics, derives compact zero-bubble pipeline strategies for those groups, and reacts to link changes through an environment adapter.

system_design.zh: 异构画像器生成设备组，策略模块选择阶段与通信映射，流水线运行时执行微批，动态适配器监测网络并更新调度参数。
system_design.en: A heterogeneity profiler creates device groups, a planner maps stages and communication, the pipeline runtime executes microbatches, and a dynamic adapter monitors the network and updates scheduling parameters.

key_results.zh: 跨区域实验中，DeepCEE 的训练吞吐明显高于所比较的通用和先进训练系统。
key_results.en: In the reported cross-region experiments, DeepCEE delivers materially higher training throughput than the compared general-purpose and state-of-the-art systems.

limitations.zh: 零气泡流水线依赖模型可合理切分；频繁网络震荡可能造成重配置开销，结论也未覆盖所有云计费和跨境数据约束。
limitations.en: Zero-bubble execution assumes the model can be partitioned effectively; rapid network oscillation can add reconfiguration overhead, and the study does not cover every cloud-pricing or data-sovereignty constraint.

baselines: widely used and state-of-the-art training systems

metrics.name: Training throughput improvement
metrics.baseline: widely used and state-of-the-art training systems

notes.zh: 已填模型、工作负载、硬件、基线和指标均来自官方 arXiv 摘要或 comment；摘要未披露的表格明细、硬件拓扑与集群配置仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Populated models, workloads, hardware, baselines, and metrics come from the official arXiv abstract or comment; undisclosed table details, hardware topology, and cluster configuration still require full-text audit.
